public_driver: MemoryDriver.resolve(public_state, public_criteria) -> (PilotMemoryView, retrieval_receipt); no full task argument
common_execution: packaging_memory_pilot.run -> packaging_experiment._run_job -> episode.run_episode -> original selected monitor and commit_physical
persistence: DECISION_READY saves complete query/view/body/receipt before send; authoritative checkpoint mirrored in memory_decisions, contexts, requests
recovery: Saved context/response/selection/monitor/commit reused without retrieval overwrite, resend, reselect, remonitor or duplicate commit. Missing or modified saved identities reject. UNKNOWN_SEND stops batch.
no_memory: Explicit empty view with none mode, same current observable base prompt as T/E.
empty_T_E: Retain assigned method, explicit empty view and reason; no query replacement.
singleton: No API request; view nonempty and actual sent nonempty separately counted.
previous_versions: v6/v7/v8 closed schemas and parent memory bytes unchanged; no historical re-signing.
monitor: pct_contact_network_v2 / pct_stability_result_v2; common selected-action-only monitor, enabled=true in plan, unchanged default false
source_archive: plan/code_snapshot/; 421 production .py/.json plus original algorithm auxiliary files bound in plan/algorithm_archive_manifest.json

frozen_retrieval.distance: mean absolute normalized feature distance; score=1/(1+distance)

historical_result_budget.interpretation: same observed outcome fields for future T/E; equal bytes do not establish fairness

frozen_retrieval.scales: container dimensions, payload; capacity uses max(payload,1); placed volume/container volume
frozen_retrieval.truncation: whole entries only; never remove conditions, costs or limitations

information_budget.differences: T normalized historical location detail; E hypotheses and evidence counts; equal caps do not establish information equivalence

historical_result.interpretation: same observed outcome fields for future T/E; equal bytes do not establish fairness

T_E_information_difference: T retains more historical normalized position detail; E adds bounded hypotheses and evidence counts. Equal caps and result fields do not establish complete information equivalence.
